==Usage==
Within the {{Tl|Information}} template on a comic panel's file page, apply <code><nowiki>{{Comicpanel}}</nowiki></code> as follows. Use <code><nowiki>{{Comicpanel|concept}}</nowiki></code> to denote comic concept art instead.
<pre>|licensing={{Comicpanel}}</pre>
